Rashi on Shabbat 55b:10:1.hebrew: זעזעת' - יראת לחטוא. לר' אליעזר ור' יהושע חטא, ולרבן גמליאל ולמודעי בקש לחטוא, ולא חטא:
Rashi on Shabbat 55b:10:1.english: You shook - You feared to sin. According to Rabbi Eliezer and Rabbi Yehoshua, [Reuben] sinned; and according to Rabban Gamliel and the Modaite, he sought to sin, but did not sin.

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:10:2.hebrew: חלית - חולי גדול, להתאפק לכבוש יצרך:
Rashi on Shabbat 55b:10:2.english: You made yourself ill - [It was] a great illness to restrain yourself [in order] to subdue your [evil] inclination.

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:12:1.hebrew: כל האומר בני עלי חטאו - באשת איש, אינו אלא טועה. ומיהו, בבזיון קדשים חטאו:
Rashi on Shabbat 55b:12:1.english: Anyone who says the sons of Eli sinned - [Meaning] with a married woman, is nothing other than mistaken. However, regarding the degradation of consecrated [offerings], they did sin.

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:13:1.hebrew: דאמר רב - לקמן בשמעתין: פנחס לא חטא, ויליף לה מקרא. ור' יונתן יליף לה לחפני מהאי קרא, דמקיש חפני לפנחס:
Rashi on Shabbat 55b:13:1.english: As Rav said - Later in our discussion, [Rav states that] Pinehas did not sin, and he derives it from a verse; and Rabbi Yonatan derives [it] for Hophni from this verse, which juxtaposes Hophni to Pinehas.

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:13:2.hebrew: ששהו את קיניהן - שהיו מסרבין להקריב שום קרבן אלא בקושי, כדכתיב (שמואל א ב׳:ט״ו): "גם בטרם יקטירון את החלב וגו'". וכשהיו זבות ויולדות באות ממקום אחר לשילה להקריב את קיניהן, והן היו משהין מלהקריבם, והנשים לא היו יכולין לסמוך עליהם שיקריבו, והיו שוהות שם, ולא היו חוזרות אצל בעליהן עד שראו קיניהן קרבין והיו טהורות לקדשים וליכנס לעזרה. לפיכך, מעלה עליהם כאילו שכבום, שהיו מונעים אותן מפריה ורביה:
Rashi on Shabbat 55b:13:2.english: That they delayed their bird-offerings - For they would refuse to sacrifice any offering except with difficulty, as it is written (I Samuel 2:15): "Also, before they burned the fat..." And when women with a discharge [zavot] and women who had given birth would come from another place to Shiloh to sacrifice their bird-offerings, and they [the priests] would delay sacrificing them, and the women were unable to rely on them to sacrifice [them], and [so] would linger there and would not return to their husbands until they saw their bird-offerings sacrificed, and were pure [to eat] consecrated foods and to enter the Courtyard. Therefore, [Scripture] considers it for them as if they had lain with them, since they were preventing them from procreation.

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:14:1.hebrew: פנחס לא חטא - באשת איש, ד״אשר ישכבון את הנשים״ אינו אלא חפני לבדו:
Rashi on Shabbat 55b:14:1.english: Pinehas did not sin - With a married woman, for “that they lay with the women” [refers] only to Hophni alone.

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:14:2.hebrew: ואחיה בן אחיטוב וגו' כהן ה' - בשילה נושא אפוד — הרי שמיחסו לשבח, ומזכיר עליו שם פנחס אבי אביו:
Rashi on Shabbat 55b:14:2.english: “And Ahijah, the son of Ahitub, etc., the Lord’s priest” - “[In Shiloh, wearing an ephod]” — behold, [Scripture] traces his lineage for praise, and mentions in connection with him the name of Pinehas, his father’s father.

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:14:3.hebrew: אפשר בא חטא לידו והכתוב מייחסו - לשבח, ואת בן בנו מייחסו אחריו? והכתיב גבי עבירה דנואפים: ״יכרת ה' לאיש וגו'״, והאי קרא בבא על הנכרית ועל הזונה מישתעי, כדדרשינן ליה באלו הן הנשרפין, דכתיב לעיל מיניה: ״כי חלל יהודה קדש ה' אשר אהב ובעל בת אל נכר״, ודרשינן: ״כי חלל יהודה קדש״ — זו זונה, וכן הוא אומר: ״לא תהיה קדשה וגו'״:
Rashi on Shabbat 55b:14:3.english: Is it possible that sin came to his hand and the verse traces his lineage - in praise, and traces the lineage of his grandson after him? But is it not written regarding the transgression of adulterers: “May the Lord cut off to the man...” (Malachi 2:12)? And this verse speaks of one who has relations with a gentile woman and with a prostitute, as we expound it in [the chapter entitled] *Elu Hen HaNisrafin*, for it is written prior to it: “For Judah has profaned the sanctuary of the Lord which He loved, and has married the daughter of a foreign god” (Malachi 2:11), and we expound: “For Judah has profaned the sanctuary” — this is a prostitute; and similarly it states: “There shall not be a harlot...” (Deuteronomy 23:18).

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:15:1.hebrew: ער - חריף להבין ולהורות בין החכמים, כדאמרי' בעירובין (דף נג:): ״אהרנית ערנית״:
Rashi on Shabbat 55b:15:1.english: Awake - Sharp to understand and to issue rulings among the Sages, as we say in Eruvin (53b): “Aharonit eranit” [an Aharonic (tractate that is) sharp and stimulating].

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:15:2.english: And if he is a priest, etc. - And here, [Scripture] traces the lineage of a priest presenting a meal-offering back to Pinehas.

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:15:3.hebrew: והכתיב אל בני כי לא טובה השמועה אשר אנכי שומע מעבירים עם ה' - אביהם היה מוכיחם:
Rashi on Shabbat 55b:15:3.english: And isn’t it written: “No, my sons, for it is not a good report that I hear; you make the Lord’s people transgress”? - Their father was rebuking them [both].

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:18:1.hebrew: והא כתיב מעבירים אמר רב הונא בריה דרב יהושע מעבירם כתיב - קשה בעיני שם החכם הנזכר כאן, כי אומר אני שטעות גדול הוא, ול"ג לה להא מילתא. שהרי בספרים מוגהים כתיב מעבירים, וגם במסורה הגדולה, במקום שמנויין שם כל התיבות דלא כתיב בהן יו"ד וקורין, ולא נמנה זה — והם מנויין ע"פ החשבון. וזו אינה קשיא: דהאי מעבירים לאו לשון עבירה הוא, אלא לשון ויעבירו קול במחנה (שמות ל״ו:ו׳). וה"ק להו: לא טובה השמועה אשר אנכי שומע, את עם ה' מעבירים — ומכריזין וקובלים עליכם. והאי מעבירים לשון רבים הוא, ואעם ה' קאי, ולאו אבני עלי, שהרי הם היו עוברים, ולא היו מעבירים את אחרים:
Rashi on Shabbat 55b:18:1.english: “Isn’t it written: ‘Ma’avirim’? Rav Huna, son of Rav Yehoshua, said: It is written ‘ma’aviram’” - The name of the Sage mentioned here is problematic in my eyes, for I say that it is a great error, and we do not maintain this reading in the text. For in proofread scrolls it is written ma’avirim; and also in the Great Masorah, where all the words that are written without a yod and read [with one] are enumerated, this [word] is not enumerated, and they are enumerated according to [an exact] count. And this is not a difficulty: for this [word] ma’avirim is not an expression of transgression, but rather an expression of “And they proclaimed [vaya’aviru kol] throughout the camp” (Exodus 36:6). And this is what he was saying to them: “The report that I hear is not good, [as] the Lord’s people are spreading [it] abroad” — proclaiming and complaining about you. And this [word] ma’avirim is in the plural, and it refers to the people of the Lord, and not to the sons of Eli; for they were transgressing [themselves], and they were not causing others to transgress.

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:3:1.hebrew: בעטיו של נחש - בעצתו של נחש שהשיא לחוה, ולא בחטא אחר, שלא חטאו. "בעטיו" — כמו "עטא וטעם" (דניאל ב):
Rashi on Shabbat 55b:3:1.english: Due to the counsel of the serpent - Through the counsel of the serpent that he gave to Eve, and not due to any other sin, for they did not sin. [The word] be’etyo is like [the expression] “eta vute’em” [counsel and discretion] (Daniel 2:14).

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:4:1.english: And their sisters - [The verse] is speaking of the sons of Yishai.

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:5:1.hebrew: אלא לאו ר"ש בן אלעזר - דאמר משה ואהרן בחטאם מתו, ומודה בהני:
Rashi on Shabbat 55b:5:1.english: Rather, is it not Rabbi Shimon ben Elazar - For he said [that] Moses and Aaron died on account of their sin, and he concedes regarding these [four].

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:6:1.english: Anyone who says that Reuben sinned - In the incident of Bilhah.

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:6:2.english: For it is written - In that [same] verse.

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:6:3.hebrew: ויהיו בני יעקב וגו' - להוציא מלבך, שלא תחשדנו:
Rashi on Shabbat 55b:6:3.english: And the sons of Jacob were, etc. - To remove [the thought] from your heart, so that you should not suspect him.

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:7:1.english: And this sin came to his hand - And [yet] would the Holy One, blessed be He, decree that they be among those who utter the curse?

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:8:1.hebrew: אחת של שכינה - כך היה יעקב עושה: בארבעה אהלי נשיו מעמיד מטה לשכינה, ובאותו אהל שהוא רואה בו השכינה, הוא בא ולן אותו הלילה:
Rashi on Shabbat 55b:8:1.english: One of the Divine Presence - This is what Jacob would do: in the four tents of his wives he would set up a bed for the Divine Presence, and in that tent in which he saw the Divine Presence, he would come and lodge that night.

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:8:2.hebrew: חללת - אותו שם שעלה על יצועי, דהיינו שכינה, מדלא כתיב ״יצועי עלית״. טעם אחר: עד שלא נבנה אהל מועד, היתה שכינה מצויה באהלי צדיקים:
Rashi on Shabbat 55b:8:2.english: You profaned - [You profaned] that Name who ascended upon my couch, that is, the Divine Presence, since it is not written: “my couch you ascended.” Another explanation: Before the Tent of Meeting was built, the Divine Presence was commonly present in the tents of the righteous.

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:9:2.hebrew: פזתה - לשון עמא פזיזא (לקמן שבת דף פח.). פזתה — מיהרת בעצמך וחטאת:
Rashi on Shabbat 55b:9:2.english: You were impulsive - An expression [similar to] “an impulsive people” (below, Shabbat 88a). [That is,] “you were impulsive” — you rushed yourself and sinned.

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:9:3.english: You acted contemptuously - You acted disrespectfully.

Rashi on Shabbat 55b:9:4.english: You prayed - To be saved from sin.

Tosafot on Shabbat 55b:12:1.hebrew: כל האומר בני עלי חטאו אינו אלא טועה - פירוש: במאי דכתיב "אשר ישכבון" לא חטאו, אלא מבזים קדשים היו, כדכתיב (שמואל א ב׳:ט״ו): "בטרם יקטירון החלב" וגו':
Tosafot on Shabbat 55b:12:1.english: “Anyone who says that the sons of Eli sinned is nothing other than mistaken” - Explanation: Regarding that which is written, “that they lay [with the women]” (I Samuel 2:22), they did not sin; rather, they treated sacred offerings with contempt, as it is written (I Samuel 2:15): “Before they burned the fat,” etc.

Tosafot on Shabbat 55b:18:1.hebrew: מעבירם כתיב - הש"ס שלנו חולק על ספרים שלנו, שכתוב בהם (מעבירים). וכן מצינו בירושלמי בשמשון: "והוא שפט את ישראל ארבעים שנה" — מלמד שהיו פלשתים יראים ממנו כ' שנה אחר מותו כמו בחייו; ובכל ספרים שלנו כתיב "כ' שנה" (שופטים טז):
Tosafot on Shabbat 55b:18:1.english: "It is written: Ma’aviram" - Our Talmud disagrees with our [biblical] books, in which it is written: (ma’avirim). And similarly we find in the Yerushalmi regarding Samson: "And he judged Israel forty years" — teaching that the Philistines feared him for twenty years after his death just as during his lifetime; yet in all our [biblical] books it is written: "twenty years" (Judges 16).

Tosafot on Shabbat 55b:19:1.hebrew: מתוך שהיה לו לפנחס למחות - פליג אר' יונתן, דאמר: שניהם לא חטאו:
Tosafot on Shabbat 55b:19:1.english: "Since Pinehas should have protested" - [This] disagrees with Rabbi Yonatan, who said that neither of them sinned.

Tosafot on Shabbat 55b:3:1.hebrew: ארבעה מתו בעטיו של נחש - והא דכתיב (קהלת ז): "כי אדם אין צדיק בארץ וגו'" — ברוב בני אדם קאמר:
Tosafot on Shabbat 55b:3:1.english: Four died due to the counsel of the serpent - And as for that which is written (Ecclesiastes 7): "For there is no righteous man on earth [who does good and does not sin]," etc. — [the verse] is speaking of the majority of people.

Tosafot on Shabbat 55b:5:1.hebrew: וש"מ יש מיתה בלא חטא ויש יסורים בלא עון - ואע"ג דבמאי דקאמר "אין יסורין בלא עון", לא איתותב:
Tosafot on Shabbat 55b:5:1.english: "And learn from it: There is death without sin and there is suffering without iniquity" - Even though regarding that which [Rav Ami] said, "There is no suffering without iniquity," he was not refuted.
